messages:
maria: Heads up — deploybot flagged a PR for tonight's change window and it's ambiguous whether this should be a patch or a minor. cc @oncall
kevin: quick read: it's telemetry + small docs update, but one change touches a JSON schema used by clients.
taylor: schema tweak is additive only (new optional field). no client break expected.
sam: additive = minor? our current rule: any public contract change -> minor. additive optional fields sometimes get treated as patch if safe.
deploybot: deploybot: PR #4321 -> labels: [docs, telemetry, schema-change]. Rule check: semver-signal=unclear.
nana: Proposal: default to patch for anything that is bugfix/docs/telemetry. If there's a schema change that could affect third-party clients, default to minor and require migration note + canary.
jen: +1 to default patch. also propose a small label `micropatch` for absolutely tiny rollouts (hotfixes <=1 file, no schema/contract touch) so releasebot can auto-pin.
kevin: How will this interact with Dedicated customers who pin to patch-only channels? They expect no minors unless agreed.
taylor: Our plan: pin stable channel to patch semantics; any PR that triggers `minor` will be blocked from stable and go through `canary` -> `staged` rollout. That preserves Dedicated expectations.
sam: I'll add a releasebot rule: if PR has `schema-change` label -> force `minor` semantics and schedule a canary with rollback guard. pseudo-rule:
```yaml
releasebot.rules:
  - if: labels contains schema-change
    set: semver: minor
    actions:
      - require: migration-note
      - schedule-canary: true
      - notify: #infra @oncall
```
jen: we should also update release notes template to include `Impact: client migration required` when `schema-change` present.
maria: Action item: change deploybot config to prefer patch unless `schema-change` or `public-api` labels exist. I'll paste the snippet after testing.
kevin: Ping me when config lands; I'll coordinate CS comms for any pinned customers.
nana: small nit: wording of labels matters. prefer `public-api` over `schema-change` to avoid ambiguity for internal-only schemas.
sam: good call. I'll map `schema-change` -> `public-api` if necessary and update mapping.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary for PR #4321 at 2025-04-07T23:15:00Z (us-west).
maria: For tonight we'll proceed as patch rollout (no `public-api` label added). If any migration label appears, we abort and reopen this thread. @sam can you push the releasebot change before next week?
sam: On it. I'll open a tiny PR to update rules and add test coverage. ETA 30m.
kevin: thanks — I'll standby with CS.
jen: :thumbsup: also added a one-line blurb to release notes template: "Impact: none / opt-in / migration required"
maria: resolved for change window. thanks everyone for quick sync. :party-parrot:
note: No title per agents.md; thread is a continuous Slack conversation.
